def standalone_live_originals(root):
    """Undo exactly the reviewed live delta to ab7edce before every older guard.

    No core, solver, kernel, publisher or wire-validator bytes are exempted. The
    original isolated fixture and all 129 baseline hashes remain immutable; only
    this finite inverse may reconstruct the approved old add-on/runtime paths.
    """
    _, assembly_originals = assembly_source_originals(root)
    _, gate_c_originals = gate_c_owner_source_originals(root)
    runtime_added, runtime_originals = windows_runtime_cache_originals(root)
    cache_added, cache_originals = windows_cache_originals(root)
    cache_originals = runtime_originals | cache_originals
    transport_added, transport_originals = windows_transport_originals(root)
    harness_originals = (
        assembly_originals
        | gate_c_originals
        | cache_originals
        | transport_originals
        | standalone_harness_originals(root)
    )
    raw = (root / STANDALONE_LIVE_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == STANDALONE_LIVE_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert set(revision) == {"schema", "base_commit", "added", "changed"}
    assert revision["schema"] == "standalone-live-python-boundary-v1"
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "ab7edce1561df34fd9eb12f62772b132f02297b9"
    added, changed = revision["added"], revision["changed"]
    assert set(added) == STANDALONE_LIVE_ADDED
    assert set(changed) == STANDALONE_LIVE_CHANGED
    assert not set(added) & set(changed)
    restored = cache_originals | transport_originals
    for name, entry in added.items():
        assert set(entry) == {"bytes", "sha256"}
        assert type(entry["bytes"]) is int and entry["bytes"] > 0
        data = (
            harness_originals[name] if name in harness_originals else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        )
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
    for name, entry in changed.items():
        assert set(entry) == {
            "reviewed_bytes",
            "reviewed_sha256",
            "original_bytes",
            "original_sha256",
            "hunks",
        }
        assert type(entry["reviewed_bytes"]) is type(entry["original_bytes"]) is int
        assert entry["reviewed_bytes"] > 0 and entry["original_bytes"] > 0
        assert entry["reviewed_sha256"] != entry["original_sha256"]
        data = (
            harness_originals[name] if name in harness_originals else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        )
        assert len(data) == entry["reviewed_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["reviewed_sha256"]
        assert type(entry["hunks"]) is list and entry["hunks"]
        previous = 0
        for hunk in entry["hunks"]:
            assert set(hunk) == {"new_start", "new_end", "original", "replacement"}
            start, end = hunk["new_start"], hunk["new_end"]
            assert type(start) is type(end) is int
            assert previous <= start <= end <= len(data)
            assert type(hunk["original"]) is type(hunk["replacement"]) is str
            assert hunk["original"] != hunk["replacement"]
            assert data[start:end] == hunk["replacement"].encode("utf-8")
            previous = end
        for hunk in reversed(entry["hunks"]):
            data = (
                data[: hunk["new_start"]]
                + hunk["original"].encode("utf-8")
                + data[hunk["new_end"] :]
            )
        assert len(data) == entry["original_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["original_sha256"]
        restored[name] = data
    old_raw = (root / STANDALONE_REVISION_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest() == STANDALONE_REVISION_SHA256
    baseline = json.loads(old_raw)["baseline_runtime"]
    _, integration_originals = standalone_integration_source_originals(root)
    integration_originals = (
        assembly_originals
        | gate_c_originals
        | integration_originals
        | redundant_solve_source_originals(root)
    )
    assert len(baseline) == 129
    for name, expected in baseline.items():
        data = (
            restored[name]
            if name in restored
            else integration_originals[name]
            if name in integration_originals
            else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        )
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected, name
    return frozenset(added) | transport_added | cache_added | runtime_added, restored


AUTHORING_REVISION_FIXTURE = "tests/fixtures/arc_authoring/python_revision_ce5b50b.json"
AUTHORING_REVISION_SHA256 = "b6c40887813846ffa5036846059ed15382b911a0da5e55d4d660d23035491f46"


def authoring_revision_originals(root):
    """Undo only the complete reviewed authoring delta before older byte guards.

    The guard module itself was already outside the historical digest; all other
    changed/new Python files must match this sealed finite revision exactly.
    Core/native/service behavior changes are forbidden by this extension. The
    separately reviewed 0.6.0 metadata exception permits one exact version file.
    """
    _, assembly_originals = assembly_source_originals(root)
    _, gate_c_originals = gate_c_owner_source_originals(root)
    geometry_added, geometry_originals = geometry_revision_originals(root)
    harness_originals = standalone_harness_originals(root)
    live_added, live_originals = standalone_live_originals(root)
    raw = (root / AUTHORING_REVISION_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == AUTHORING_REVISION_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "ce5b50bb011b3949a6599c7cbc28d31024805e0a"
    assert revision["schema"] == "arc-authoring-python-boundary-v1"
    added, changed = revision["added"], revision["changed"]
    assert not set(added) & set(changed)
    metadata_path = "src/mechanical_cad/__init__.py"
    assert all(name.startswith(("blender_addon/", "tests/")) for name in added)
    assert all(
        name.startswith(("blender_addon/", "tests/")) or name == metadata_path for name in changed
    )
    restored = (
        assembly_step_originals(root)[1]
        | assembly_originals
        | geometry_originals
        | harness_originals
        | live_originals
    )
    before = (
        assembly_originals
        | gate_c_originals
        | geometry_originals
        | harness_originals
        | live_originals
    )
    for name, entry in added.items():
        data = before[name] if name in before else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
    for name, entry in changed.items():
        data = before[name] if name in before else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        if name == metadata_path:
            assert data == (
                b'"""Independent, serializable CAD model. Blender and OCP are optional at import time."""\n'
                b'\n__version__ = "0.6.0"\n'
            )
        assert len(data) == entry["reviewed_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["reviewed_sha256"]
        previous = 0
        for hunk in entry["hunks"]:
            start, end = hunk["new_start"], hunk["new_end"]
            assert type(start) is type(end) is int
            assert previous <= start <= end <= len(data)
            assert data[start:end] == hunk["replacement"].encode("utf-8")
            previous = end
        for hunk in reversed(entry["hunks"]):
            data = (
                data[: hunk["new_start"]]
                + hunk["original"].encode("utf-8")
                + data[hunk["new_end"] :]
            )
        assert len(data) == entry["original_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["original_sha256"]
        restored[name] = data
    return frozenset(added) | live_added | geometry_added, restored


SERVICE_REVISION_FIXTURE = "tests/fixtures/result_v3/service_python_revision_30383a1.json"
SERVICE_REVISION_SHA256 = "18c633d6a05c7f0c330b24f0815370b8b164284a43c03fd3daed88f2f84f3de0"


def service_revision_originals(root):
    """Undo only the complete pinned service delta before the historical digest."""
    authoring_added, authoring_originals = authoring_revision_originals(root)
    raw = (root / SERVICE_REVISION_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == SERVICE_REVISION_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "30383a1bbaeae02b447bab2c37290d5f3927df8c"
    assert revision["schema"] == "result-v3-python-boundary-v1"
    added = revision["added"]
    changed = revision["changed"]
    assert len(added) == 21 and len(changed) == 11
    assert not set(added) & set(changed)
    before = authoring_originals | redundant_solve_source_originals(root)
    for name, entry in added.items():
        data = before.get(name, (root / name).read_bytes())
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
    restored = dict(authoring_originals)
    for name, entry in changed.items():
        data = authoring_originals.get(name, (root / name).read_bytes())
        assert len(data) == entry["reviewed_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["reviewed_sha256"]
        previous = 0
        for hunk in entry["hunks"]:
            start, end = hunk["new_start"], hunk["new_end"]
            assert type(start) is type(end) is int
            assert previous <= start <= end <= len(data)
            assert data[start:end] == hunk["replacement"].encode("utf-8")
            previous = end
        for hunk in reversed(entry["hunks"]):
            data = (
                data[: hunk["new_start"]]
                + hunk["original"].encode("utf-8")
                + data[hunk["new_end"] :]
            )
        assert len(data) == entry["original_bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["original_sha256"]
        restored[name] = data
    return frozenset(added) | authoring_added, restored


STANDALONE_REVISION_FIXTURE = "tests/fixtures/standalone/python_additions_69d0f81.json"
STANDALONE_REVISION_SHA256 = "0e6152a913e23079c770f23bbe6daf111d28f82981496e1c85af19ae1bc5c6c9"


def standalone_revision_added(root):
    """Retain the exact isolated fixture after the finite live inverse."""
    _live_added, live_originals = standalone_live_originals(root)
    raw = (root / STANDALONE_REVISION_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == STANDALONE_REVISION_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert revision["schema"] == "standalone-isolated-additions-v1"
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "69d0f8164e73bfbbcdf0c48d6546f97803d12f58"
    assert set(revision) == {"schema", "base_commit", "added", "baseline_runtime"}
    added = revision["added"]
    assert set(added) == {
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/backend_platform.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/windows_process.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/runtime_bundle_manifest.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/runtime_bundle_materialize.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/runtime_bundle_pin.py",
        "scripts/package_standalone_extension.py",
        "scripts/standalone_child_bootstrap.py",
        "tests/unit/test_runtime_bundle_manifest.py",
        "tests/unit/test_runtime_bundle_materialize.py",
        "tests/unit/test_runtime_bundle_pin.py",
        "tests/unit/test_standalone_child_bootstrap.py",
        "tests/unit/test_windows_process.py",
        "tests/unit/test_standalone_extension_builder.py",
        "tests/unit/test_standalone_runtime_boundary.py",
    }
    for name, entry in added.items():
        data = live_originals[name] if name in live_originals else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
        assert len(data) == entry["bytes"]
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
    return frozenset(added)


def protected_python_digest(root):
    visual_added, _ = visual_joint_originals(root)
    export_added, _ = assembly_step_originals(root)
    assembly_added, _ = assembly_source_originals(root)
    gate_c_added, _ = gate_c_owner_source_originals(root)
    service_added, service_originals = service_revision_originals(root)
    standalone_added = standalone_revision_added(root)
    inventory = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_inventory.py"
    service_originals = {
        inventory: inventory_guard_harness_originals(root)[inventory],
        **service_originals,
    }
    excluded = {
        "src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py",
        "src/mechanical_cad/arc_profile_native_evidence.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py",
        # Authorized periodic-plan revision; all other snapshot3 paths stay exact.
        "src/mechanical_cad/arc_profile_native_plan.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_periodic.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_mass_observations.py",
        # Precisely revised finite-parameter/count assertions, audited separately.
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_plan.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_evidence.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_radial_trim.py",
        # Precisely scoped canonical native endpoint/whole-trace controls.
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_vertices.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_vertex_adapter.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_generated_trace.py",
        # Exact new advisory-only metadata controls; no broader exclusion.
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_regularity.py",
        "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_regularity_adapter.py",
    }
    paths = sorted(
        path
        for directory in ("src", "blender_addon", "tests")
        for path in (root / directory).rglob("*.py")
        if path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        not in excluded
        | service_added
        | standalone_added
        | gate_c_added
        | assembly_added
        | export_added
        | visual_added
    )
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for path in paths:
        name = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        digest.update(
            name.encode()
            + b"\0"
            + (
                service_originals[name]
                if name in service_originals
                else _release_070_bytes(root, name)
            )
            + b"\0"
        )
    return len(paths), digest.hexdigest()


# Recorded from the independently frozen revised_pure_snapshot3/source. These
# portable hashes neither read that checkout at test time nor relax old guards.
SNAPSHOT3_KERNEL_PROTECTED = "623eea032aff3864b5fa2d8329314ef22894a53a59c8f3229348745d46f884c4"
SNAPSHOT3_EVIDENCE_PROTECTED = "f2f68e0ac97da4020e773ed470b90e7819df67587ed09bde1e1588dbc29f1770"
SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED = (
    259,
    "f1c9a006975a48a8ef3fb051709eb4ac75a0dadc207090c27783902034e939b7",
)


def test_snapshot3_source_and_all_old_kernel_evidence_spans_are_protected():
    assert (
        hashlib.sha256(protected_kernel_bytes(KERNEL.read_bytes())).hexdigest()
        == SNAPSHOT3_KERNEL_PROTECTED
    )
    path = ROOT / "src/mechanical_cad/arc_profile_native_evidence.py"
    assert (
        hashlib.sha256(protected_evidence_bytes(path.read_bytes())).hexdigest()
        == SNAPSHOT3_EVIDENCE_PROTECTED
    )
    assert protected_python_digest(ROOT) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


def copy_python_guard_tree(destination):
    for directory in ("src", "blender_addon", "tests"):
        for source in (ROOT / directory).rglob("*.py"):
            target = destination / source.relative_to(ROOT)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    for relative in (
        VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE,
        RELEASE_071_FIXTURE,
        ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE,
        RELEASE_070_FIXTURE,
        ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_FIXTURE,
        ASSEMBLY_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_FIXTURE,
        GATE_C_OWNER_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_FIXTURE,
        REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        SERVICE_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        AUTHORING_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        GEOMETRY_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        INTEGRATION_SOURCE_FIXTURE,
        INTEGRATION_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        STANDALONE_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        STANDALONE_LIVE_FIXTURE,
        STANDALONE_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_CACHE_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_CACHE_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_REVISION_FIXTURE,
        WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_HARNESS_FIXTURE,
        "scripts/package_standalone_extension.py",
        "scripts/standalone_child_bootstrap.py",
        *VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS,
    ):
        fixture = destination / relative
        fixture.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fixture.write_bytes((ROOT / relative).read_bytes())
    assert protected_python_digest(destination) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    [
        "src/mechanical_cad/profile_adapter_v3.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/result_v3.py",
        "tests/unit/test_sector_service_v3.py",
        "src/mechanical_cad/engine.py",
        "tests/unit/test_backend_contract_server.py",
        "src/mechanical_cad/model.py",
    ],
)
def test_service_extension_never_exempts_unreviewed_python_bytes(tmp_path, name):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# Unreviewed mutation.\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        assert protected_python_digest(tmp_path) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


def test_service_extension_never_exempts_unlisted_python_path(tmp_path):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "src/mechanical_cad/unreviewed.py").write_text("pass\n")
    assert protected_python_digest(tmp_path) != SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


def test_service_extension_rejects_tampered_revision_fixture(tmp_path):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / SERVICE_REVISION_FIXTURE
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)

def test_constructor_and_later_mandatory_gates_remain_in_original_order():
    method = kernel_method("extrude_sector")
    calls = [node for node in ast.walk(method) if isinstance(node, ast.Call)]
    constructor = [
        node
        for node in calls
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism"
    ]
    assert len(constructor) == 1
    assert (
        ast.unparse(constructor[0])
        == "BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism(profile, gp_Vec(*vector), False, True)"
    )
    validator = next(
        node
        for node in calls
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "validate_end_cap_observation"
    )
    required = {
        "native_generated_history_changed",
        "native_split_merged_history",
        "native_tolerance_exceeded",
        "native_extrusion_surface_changed",
    }
    guards = [
        node
        for node in calls
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
        and node.func.id == "_require"
        and any(isinstance(arg, ast.Constant) and arg.value in required for arg in node.args)
    ]
    # The four original gates remain, plus the bounded-history overflow gate.
    assert len(guards) == 5 and all(validator.lineno < node.lineno for node in guards)
    codes = [
        arg.value
        for node in guards
        for arg in node.args
        if isinstance(arg, ast.Constant) and arg.value in required
    ]
    assert {code: codes.count(code) for code in required} == {
        "native_generated_history_changed": 2,
        "native_split_merged_history": 1,
        "native_tolerance_exceeded": 1,
        "native_extrusion_surface_changed": 1,
    }
    volume = next(
        node
        for node in calls
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "_exact_volume"
    )
    masses = next(
        node for node in calls if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "check_masses"
    )
    registration = next(
        node
        for node in calls
        if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == "_remember"
    )
    assert max(node.lineno for node in guards) < volume.lineno < masses.lineno < registration.lineno
    assert (
        ast.unparse(masses)
        == "check_masses(plan, state.area, context=c, height=height, volume=volume)"
    )
    assert not any(
        isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
        and node.func.id in {"PrimitiveContext", "entry_context", "IntervalContext"}
        for node in calls
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("row,column", itertools.product(range(3), range(3)))
@pytest.mark.parametrize("location", ["shape_location", "surface_location"])
def test_every_linear_matrix_entry_is_exact_without_epsilon(plan, row, column, location):
    record = observation(plan)
    values = [list(entry) for entry in record[location]["matrix"]]
    values[row][column] = math.nextafter(values[row][column], math.inf)
    record[location]["matrix"] = tuple(tuple(entry) for entry in values)
    with pytest.raises(NativePlanError):
        validate(plan, record)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("where", ["plan", "support", "context", "height"])
def test_record_context_and_independent_height_subclasses_reject(plan, where):
    context, height = PrimitiveContext(), 7.0
    record = observation(plan)
    if where == "plan":

        class Derived(NativePlan):
            pass

        plan = Derived(**{field.name: getattr(plan, field.name) for field in fields(NativePlan)})
    elif where == "support":

        class Derived(NativeActualSupport):
            pass

        support = Derived(
            **{
                field.name: getattr(plan.accepted_support, field.name)
                for field in fields(NativeActualSupport)
            }
        )
        plan = replace(plan, accepted_support=support)
    elif where == "context":

        class Derived(PrimitiveContext):
            pass

        context = Derived()
    else:
        height = Float(7.0)
    with pytest.raises(NativePlanError):
        validate(plan, record, height=height, context=context)


def test_integration_restores_exact_standalone_and_recovered_geometry_boundaries():
    added, source = standalone_integration_source_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(added) == 7 and len(source) == 5
    assert set(source) == set(INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    harness = standalone_integration_harness_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(harness) == 5 and set(harness) == set(INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    for name, data in (source | harness).items():
        expected = (INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS | INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)[name]
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected
    geometry_added, geometry = geometry_revision_originals(ROOT)
    assert geometry_added == added and len(geometry) == 8
    assert all(geometry[name] == data for name, data in source.items())
    assert protected_python_digest(ROOT) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    sorted(
        INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ADDED
        | INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS.keys()
        | INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS.keys()
    ),
)
def test_geometry_extension_rejects_each_unreviewed_python_mutation(tmp_path, name):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# Unreviewed geometry integration mutation.\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "fixture", [GEOMETRY_REVISION_FIXTURE, INTEGRATION_SOURCE_FIXTURE, INTEGRATION_HARNESS_FIXTURE]
)
def test_geometry_extension_rejects_tampered_fixture(tmp_path, fixture):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / fixture
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_integration_harness_pair_cannot_replace_trusted_validator(tmp_path, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / INTEGRATION_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = (
            hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if mutation == "coordinated"
            else "f" * 64
        )
        before = (
            'STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256 = (\n    "'
            + STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256
            + '"\n)'
        ).encode()
        after = ('STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256 = (\n    "' + digest + '"\n)').encode()
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(before) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(before, after))
    if mutation == "helper":
        before = b"\ndef standalone_integration_harness_originals(root):\n"
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(before) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(before, before + b" # unreviewed"))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        standalone_integration_harness_originals(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "constant",
    [
        "INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SHA256",
        "GEOMETRY_REVISION_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_LIVE_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_CACHE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_CACHE_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_REVISION_SHA256",
        "AUTHORING_REVISION_SHA256",
        "SERVICE_REVISION_SHA256",
    ],
)
def test_integration_harness_normalizes_no_other_digest_slot(tmp_path, constant):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    data, digest = guard.read_bytes(), globals()[constant].encode("ascii")
    assert data.count(digest) == 1
    guard.write_bytes(data.replace(digest, b"f" * 64))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        standalone_integration_harness_originals(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    [
        "schema",
        "base",
        "extra_key",
        "missing_path",
        "extra_path",
        "production_path",
        "original_hash",
        "reviewed_hash",
        "original_length",
        "reviewed_length",
        "entry_key",
        "hunk_key",
        "empty_hunks",
        "start_negative",
        "start_bool",
        "end_bool",
        "end_before_start",
        "end_overflow",
        "replacement",
        "original",
        "duplicate_hunk",
        "reversed_hunks",
        "forged_original",
    ],
)
def test_integration_inverse_inner_schema_hunks_and_pinned_originals(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, kind, mutation
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    fixture = INTEGRATION_SOURCE_FIXTURE if kind == "source" else INTEGRATION_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    function = (
        standalone_integration_source_originals
        if kind == "source"
        else standalone_integration_harness_originals
    )
    # Establish the clean positive path before bypassing this layer's outer digest.
    clean = function(tmp_path)
    original = clean[1] if kind == "source" else clean
    revision = json.loads((tmp_path / fixture).read_bytes())
    name = (
        "src/mechanical_cad/actions.py"
        if kind == "source"
        else "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_incidence.py"
    )
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    hunk = entry["hunks"][0]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "other"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "0" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["allow_other_paths"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing_path":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra_path":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/test_unreviewed.py"] = dict(entry)
    elif mutation == "production_path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation in {"original_hash", "reviewed_hash"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_hash", "_sha256")] = "0" * 64
    elif mutation in {"original_length", "reviewed_length"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length", "_bytes")] = True
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "start_negative":
        hunk["new_start"] = -1
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = False
    elif mutation == "end_bool":
        hunk["new_end"] = True
    elif mutation == "end_before_start":
        hunk["new_end"] = hunk["new_start"] - 1
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":
        hunk["new_end"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation == "replacement":
        hunk["replacement"] += "# altered reviewed bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "original":
        hunk["original"] += "# altered before bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate_hunk":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    elif mutation == "reversed_hunks":
        assert len(entry["hunks"]) > 1
        entry["hunks"].reverse()
    else:
        assert mutation == "forged_original"
        before = original[name] + b"\n# forged original\n"
        current = (tmp_path / name).read_bytes()
        entry["original_bytes"] = len(before)
        entry["original_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": before.decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    (tmp_path / fixture).write_bytes(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    constant = (
        "INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SHA256" if kind == "source" else "STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256"
    )
    if kind == "harness":
        outer_before = redundant_solve_harness_originals(tmp_path)
        before = (
            'STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256 = (\n    "'
            + STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256
            + '"\n)'
        ).encode()
        after = ('STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256 = (\n    "' + digest + '"\n)').encode()
        data = outer_before["tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"]
        assert data.count(before) == 1
        path = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
        assert outer_before[path].count(before) == 1
        outer_before[path] = outer_before[path].replace(before, after)
        monkeypatch.setitem(
            globals(), "redundant_solve_harness_originals", lambda _root: outer_before
        )
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), constant, digest)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        function(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation", ["missing", "extra", "wrong_directory", "entry_key", "length_bool", "hash"]
)
def test_integration_source_added_paths_remain_exact(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    standalone_integration_source_originals(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / INTEGRATION_SOURCE_FIXTURE
    revision = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    name = sorted(revision["added"])[0]
    if mutation == "missing":
        revision["added"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra":
        revision["added"]["src/mechanical_cad/unreviewed.py"] = revision["added"][name]
    elif mutation == "wrong_directory":
        revision["added"]["src/impostor/geometry_result_v3.py"] = revision["added"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        revision["added"][name]["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "length_bool":
        revision["added"][name]["bytes"] = True
    else:
        revision["added"][name]["sha256"] = "0" * 64
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    path.write_bytes(raw)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        standalone_integration_source_originals(tmp_path)


def test_redundant_solve_restores_only_exact_cc130e6_paths_and_old_return_sets():
    source = redundant_solve_source_originals(ROOT)
    harness = redundant_solve_harness_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(source) == 2 and len(harness) == 4
    assert set(source) == set(REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    assert set(harness) == set(REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    for name, data in (source | harness).items():
        expected = (REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_ORIGINALS | REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)[name]
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected
    added, original = standalone_integration_source_originals(ROOT)
    assert added == INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ADDED
    assert set(original) == set(INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    assert set(standalone_integration_harness_originals(ROOT)) == set(INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    assert protected_python_digest(ROOT) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    sorted(REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_ORIGINALS.keys() | REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS.keys()),
)
def test_redundant_solve_outer_layer_never_exempts_unreviewed_bytes(tmp_path, name):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# unreviewed correction mutation\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_redundant_solve_copied_fixture_and_guard_cannot_replace_trusted_code(
    tmp_path, kind, mutation
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    prefix = "REDUNDANT_SOLVE_" + kind.upper()
    fixture = tmp_path / globals()[prefix + "_FIXTURE"]
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = (
            hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if mutation == "coordinated"
            else "f" * 64
        )
        old = globals()[prefix + "_SHA256"].encode()
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, digest.encode()))
    if mutation == "helper":
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        marker = ("def redundant_solve_" + kind + "_originals(root):").encode()
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(marker, marker + b" # poisoned copied validator"))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    [
        "schema",
        "base",
        "extra_key",
        "missing",
        "extra",
        "production",
        "before_pin",
        "hunk",
        "equivalent",
    ],
)
def test_redundant_solve_inner_controls_are_nonvacuous(tmp_path, monkeypatch, kind, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    outer_before = inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path) if kind == "harness" else None
    prefix = "REDUNDANT_SOLVE_" + kind.upper()
    function = globals()["redundant_solve_" + kind + "_originals"]
    expected = function(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / globals()[prefix + "_FIXTURE"]
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    name = (
        "tests/unit/test_result_v3_client.py"
        if kind == "source"
        else "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_incidence.py"
    )
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "other"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "0" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/unreviewed.py"] = entry
    elif mutation == "production":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "before_pin":
        entry["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "hunk":
        entry["hunks"][0]["new_start"] = True
    else:
        # Changed serialization must really reach and pass the complete inner
        # inverse, rather than having every negative fail at an earlier seal.
        current = outer_before[name] if kind == "harness" else (tmp_path / name).read_bytes()
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": expected[name].decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if kind == "harness":
        guard = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
        old = REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
        data = outer_before[guard]
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        outer_before[guard] = data.replace(old, digest.encode())
        monkeypatch.setitem(
            globals(), "inventory_guard_harness_originals", lambda _root: outer_before
        )
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), prefix + "_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert function(tmp_path) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            function(tmp_path)


def test_integration_harness_equivalent_inner_repin_passes_below_new_outer_layer(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    expected = standalone_integration_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    before = redundant_solve_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / INTEGRATION_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_incidence.py"
    revision["changed"][name]["hunks"] = [
        {
            "new_start": 0,
            "new_end": len(before[name]),
            "original": expected[name].decode(),
            "replacement": before[name].decode(),
        }
    ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    path = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    old = STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
    assert before[path].count(old) == 1
    before[path] = before[path].replace(old, digest.encode())
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "redundant_solve_harness_originals", lambda _root: before)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256", digest)
    assert standalone_integration_harness_originals(tmp_path) == expected


def test_inventory_guard_harness_restores_exact_a88ac4f_and_old_boundaries():
    originals = inventory_guard_harness_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(originals) == 5 and set(originals) == set(INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    for name, data in originals.items():
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_ORIGINALS[
            name
        ]
    assert len(redundant_solve_source_originals(ROOT)) == 2
    assert len(redundant_solve_harness_originals(ROOT)) == 4
    for function, expected in (
        (redundant_solve_harness_originals, REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (standalone_integration_harness_originals, INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_runtime_cache_harness_originals, WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_cache_harness_originals, WINDOWS_CACHE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_transport_harness_originals, WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (standalone_harness_originals, STANDALONE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
    ):
        restored = function(ROOT)
        assert set(restored) == set(expected)
        assert "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_inventory.py" not in restored
        for name, data in restored.items():
            assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected[name]
    added, source = standalone_integration_source_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(added) == 7 and added == INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ADDED
    assert len(source) == 5 and set(source) == set(INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    geometry_added, geometry = geometry_revision_originals(ROOT)
    assert geometry_added == added and len(geometry) == 8
    assert protected_python_digest(ROOT) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_ORIGINALS))
def test_inventory_guard_outer_rejects_each_unreviewed_test_path(tmp_path, name):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# Unreviewed inventory guard mutation.\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["remove", "redirect"])
def test_inventory_guard_binding_changes_cannot_escape_seal(tmp_path, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_inventory.py"
    binding = b'        "TRUSTED_GUARD_ROOT": ROOT,\n'
    data = path.read_bytes()
    assert data.count(binding) == 1
    replacement = b"" if mutation == "remove" else binding.replace(b"ROOT,", b"ROOT.parent,")
    path.write_bytes(data.replace(binding, replacement))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_inventory_guard_copied_fixture_and_code_are_only_data(tmp_path, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = (
            hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if mutation == "coordinated"
            else "f" * 64
        )
        old = INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, digest.encode()))
    if mutation in {"helper", "coordinated"}:
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        marker = b"def inventory_guard_harness_originals(root):\n"
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(
            data.replace(marker, marker + b'    raise RuntimeError("copied code executed")\n')
        )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    [
        "schema",
        "base",
        "extra_key",
        "missing_path",
        "extra_path",
        "production_path",
        "original_hash",
        "original_length",
        "original_length_bool",
        "reviewed_hash",
        "reviewed_length",
        "reviewed_length_bool",
        "reviewed_length_negative",
        "entry_key",
        "hunk_key",
        "empty_hunks",
        "start_negative",
        "start_bool",
        "start_overflow",
        "end_bool",
        "end_negative",
        "end_before_start",
        "end_overflow",
        "replacement",
        "original",
        "duplicate_hunk",
        "overlapping_hunks",
        "reversed_hunks",
        "equivalent",
    ],
)
def test_inventory_guard_inner_controls_are_nonvacuous(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mutation):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    outer_before = gate_c_owner_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    expected = inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    assert len(entry["hunks"]) > 1
    hunk = entry["hunks"][0]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "other"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "0" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing_path":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra_path":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/unreviewed.py"] = dict(entry)
    elif mutation == "production_path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation in {"original_hash", "reviewed_hash"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_hash", "_sha256")] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation in {"original_length", "reviewed_length"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length", "_bytes")] += 1
    elif mutation in {"original_length_bool", "reviewed_length_bool"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length_bool", "_bytes")] = True
    elif mutation == "reviewed_length_negative":
        entry["reviewed_bytes"] = -1
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "start_negative":
        hunk["new_start"] = -1
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = False
    elif mutation == "start_overflow":
        hunk["new_start"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation == "end_bool":
        hunk["new_end"] = True
    elif mutation == "end_negative":
        hunk["new_end"] = -1
    elif mutation == "end_before_start":
        hunk["new_end"] = hunk["new_start"] - 1
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":
        hunk["new_end"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation in {"replacement", "original"}:
        hunk[mutation] += "# unreviewed\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate_hunk":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    elif mutation == "overlapping_hunks":
        entry["hunks"][1]["new_start"] = hunk["new_end"] - 1
    elif mutation == "reversed_hunks":
        entry["hunks"].reverse()
    else:
        current = outer_before[name]
        label = b"INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_" + b'SHA256 = "'
        slot = label + INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256.encode() + b'"'
        assert current.count(slot) == 1
        current = current.replace(slot, label + b"0" * 64 + b'"')
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": expected[name].decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    data, old = outer_before[name], INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
    assert data.count(old) == 1
    outer_before[name] = data.replace(old, digest.encode())
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "gate_c_owner_harness_originals", lambda _root: outer_before)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)


def test_gate_c_owner_restores_exact_de70a45_then_every_unchanged_historical_layer():
    added, source = gate_c_owner_source_originals(ROOT)
    harness = gate_c_owner_harness_originals(ROOT)
    assert len(added) == 3 and added == GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_ADDED
    assert len(source) == 18 and set(source) == set(GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    assert len(harness) == 5 and set(harness) == set(GATE_C_OWNER_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    assert not added & (source.keys() | harness.keys())
    assert all(name.startswith("tests/") for name in added)
    for name, data in (source | harness).items():
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == (
            GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_ORIGINALS | GATE_C_OWNER_HARNESS_ORIGINALS
        )[name]
    # Each old layer keeps its exact return set and independent original pins.
    for function, expected in (
        (inventory_guard_harness_originals, INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (redundant_solve_source_originals, REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_ORIGINALS),
        (redundant_solve_harness_originals, REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (standalone_integration_harness_originals, INTEGRATION_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_runtime_cache_harness_originals, WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_cache_harness_originals, WINDOWS_CACHE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (windows_transport_harness_originals, WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
        (standalone_harness_originals, STANDALONE_HARNESS_ORIGINALS),
    ):
        restored = function(ROOT)
        assert set(restored) == set(expected)
        for name, data in restored.items():
            assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected[name]
    integration_added, integration = standalone_integration_source_originals(ROOT)
    assert integration_added == INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ADDED and len(integration_added) == 7
    assert set(integration) == set(INTEGRATION_SOURCE_ORIGINALS) and len(integration) == 5
    geometry_added, geometry = geometry_revision_originals(ROOT)
    assert geometry_added == integration_added and len(geometry) == 8
    assert protected_python_digest(ROOT) == SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name",
    sorted(
        GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_ADDED
        | GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_ORIGINALS.keys()
        | GATE_C_OWNER_HARNESS_ORIGINALS.keys()
    ),
)
def test_gate_c_owner_seal_rejects_every_unlisted_hunk(tmp_path, name):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# Unlisted Gate C hunk.\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_gate_c_owner_copied_validator_constants_and_fixtures_are_only_data(
    tmp_path, kind, mutation
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    prefix = "GATE_C_OWNER_" + kind.upper()
    fixture = tmp_path / globals()[prefix + "_FIXTURE"]
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        old = globals()[prefix + "_SHA256"].encode()
        replacement = (
            hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode()
            if mutation == "coordinated"
            else b"f" * 64
        )
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, replacement))
    if mutation == "helper":
        old = ("def gate_c_owner_" + kind + "_originals(root):\n").encode()
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, old + b"    # Untrusted copied validator.\n"))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        protected_python_digest(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "constant",
    [
        "GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_SHA256",
        "INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "REDUNDANT_SOLVE_SOURCE_SHA256",
        "REDUNDANT_SOLVE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_INTEGRATION_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "GEOMETRY_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_RUNTIME_CACHE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_CACHE_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_CACHE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_REVISION_SHA256",
        "WINDOWS_TRANSPORT_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_LIVE_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_HARNESS_SHA256",
        "STANDALONE_REVISION_SHA256",
        "AUTHORING_REVISION_SHA256",
        "SERVICE_REVISION_SHA256",
    ],
)
def test_gate_c_owner_normalizes_only_its_own_outer_digest_slot(tmp_path, constant):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    data, old = guard.read_bytes(), globals()[constant].encode()
    assert data.count(old) == 1
    guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, b"f" * 64))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        gate_c_owner_harness_originals(tmp_path)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    [
        "schema",
        "base",
        "extra_key",
        "missing",
        "extra",
        "production",
        "before_pin",
        "before_length",
        "reviewed_hash",
        "reviewed_length",
        "entry_key",
        "empty_hunks",
        "hunk_key",
        "start_bool",
        "end_overflow",
        "replacement",
        "original",
        "duplicate",
        "forged_original",
        "equivalent",
    ],
)
def test_gate_c_owner_inner_schema_hunks_and_pinned_originals_are_nonvacuous(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, kind, mutation
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    function = globals()["gate_c_owner_" + kind + "_originals"]
    outer_before = (
        assembly_source_originals(tmp_path)[1]
        if kind == "source"
        else assembly_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    )
    prefix = "GATE_C_OWNER_" + kind.upper()
    clean = function(tmp_path)
    expected = clean[1] if kind == "source" else clean
    name = (
        "src/mechanical_cad/backend_contract.py"
        if kind == "source"
        else "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_incidence.py"
    )
    fixture = tmp_path / globals()[prefix + "_FIXTURE"]
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    hunk = entry["hunks"][0]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "other"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "0" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/unreviewed.py"] = dict(entry)
    elif mutation == "production":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "before_pin":
        entry["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "before_length":
        entry["original_bytes"] = True
    elif mutation == "reviewed_hash":
        entry["reviewed_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "reviewed_length":
        entry["reviewed_bytes"] = True
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = True
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":
        hunk["new_end"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation in {"replacement", "original"}:
        hunk[mutation] += "# Altered hunk bytes.\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    else:
        current = outer_before.get(name, (tmp_path / name).read_bytes())
        before = expected[name]
        if mutation == "forged_original":
            before += b"\n# Forged pinned original.\n"
            entry["original_bytes"] = len(before)
            entry["original_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        else:
            assert mutation == "equivalent"
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": before.decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if kind == "harness":
        name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
        data, old = outer_before[name], GATE_C_OWNER_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        outer_before[name] = data.replace(old, digest.encode())
        monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "assembly_harness_originals", lambda _root: outer_before)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), prefix + "_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert function(tmp_path) == clean
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            function(tmp_path)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation", ["missing", "extra", "wrong_directory", "entry_key", "length_bool", "hash"]
)
def test_gate_c_owner_new_tests_have_exact_paths_bytes_and_no_before_image(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, mutation
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    added, before = gate_c_owner_source_originals(tmp_path)
    assert len(added) == 3 and not added & before.keys()
    fixture = tmp_path / GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_FIXTURE
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    name = sorted(added)[0]
    if mutation == "missing":
        revision["added"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "extra":
        revision["added"]["tests/unit/unreviewed.py"] = dict(revision["added"][name])
    elif mutation == "wrong_directory":
        revision["added"]["src/mechanical_cad/unreviewed.py"] = revision["added"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        revision["added"][name]["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "length_bool":
        revision["added"][name]["bytes"] = True
    else:
        revision["added"][name]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "GATE_C_OWNER_SOURCE_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        gate_c_owner_source_originals(tmp_path)

    assert protected_python_digest(tmp_path) != SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED

    tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    expected = standalone_integration_source_originals(tmp_path)
    _, before = gate_c_owner_source_originals(tmp_path)
    fixture = tmp_path / INTEGRATION_SOURCE_FIXTURE
    revision = json.loads(fixture.read_bytes())
    name = "src/mechanical_cad/actions.py"
    current = before[name]
    revision["changed"][name]["hunks"] = [
        {
            "new_start": 0,
            "new_end": len(current),
            "original": expected[1][name].decode(),
            "replacement": current.decode(),
        }
    ]
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != fixture.read_bytes()
    fixture.write_bytes(raw)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "INTEGRATION_SOURCE_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    assert standalone_integration_source_originals(tmp_path) == expected
