def test_assembly_integration_restores_exact_parent_and_all_historical_guards():
    added, source = assembly_source_originals(ROOT)
    harness = assembly_harness_originals(ROOT)
    assert added == ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_ADDED
    assert all(name.startswith("tests/") for name in added)
    assert not added & (source.keys() | harness.keys())
    assert set(source) == set(ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_ORIGINALS)
    assert set(harness) == set(ASSEMBLY_HARNESS_ORIGINALS)
    for name, data in (source | harness).items():
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == (
            ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_ORIGINALS | ASSEMBLY_HARNESS_ORIGINALS
        )[name]
    test_gate_c_owner_restores_exact_de70a45_then_every_unchanged_historical_layer()


def test_assembly_integration_rejects_every_changed_added_guard_and_fixture_byte(monkeypatch):
    """Mutate read observations, avoiding a full tree copy for each finite path."""
    read = Path.read_bytes
    for names, function in (
        (
            ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_ADDED | ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_ORIGINALS.keys() | {ASSEMBLY_SOURCE_FIXTURE},
            assembly_source_originals,
        ),
        (
            ASSEMBLY_HARNESS_ORIGINALS.keys() | {ASSEMBLY_HARNESS_FIXTURE},
            assembly_harness_originals,
        ),
    ):
        for name in sorted(names):
            target = ROOT / name
            with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
                patch.setattr(
                    Path,
                    "read_bytes",
                    lambda path, target=target: read(path) + (b"\n" if path == target else b""),
                )
                with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
                    function(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["source", "harness"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["equivalent", "schema", "path", "original", "hunk"])
def test_assembly_integration_inner_controls_keep_independent_before_pins(
    monkeypatch, kind, mutation
):
    function = globals()["assembly_" + kind + "_originals"]
    prefix = "ASSEMBLY_" + kind.upper()
    expected = function(ROOT)
    fixture = ROOT / globals()[prefix + "_FIXTURE"]
    read = Path.read_bytes
    original_raw = read(fixture)
    revision = json.loads(original_raw)
    name = next(iter(revision["changed"]))
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "unreviewed"
    elif mutation == "path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "original":
        revision["changed"][name]["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "hunk":
        revision["changed"][name]["hunks"][0]["new_start"] = True
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != original_raw
    old = globals()[prefix + "_SHA256"]
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"

    def observed(path):
        if path == fixture:
            return raw
        data = read(path)
        if kind == "harness" and path == guard:
            assert data.count(old.encode()) == 1
            return data.replace(old.encode(), digest.encode())
        return data

    # Exercise the original inner assertions after this metadata-only outer layer.
    metadata_before = _release_070_bytes(ROOT, "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py")
    metadata_read = _release_070_bytes
    monkeypatch.setitem(
        globals(),
        "_release_070_bytes",
        lambda root, path: (
            metadata_before.replace(old.encode(), digest.encode())
            if kind == "harness" and path == "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
            else metadata_read(root, path)
        ),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", observed)
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), prefix + "_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert function(ROOT) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            function(ROOT)


def test_release_070_metadata_restores_exact_eb9b51c_bytes():
    for name, expected in RELEASE_070_ORIGINALS.items():
        data = _release_070_bytes(ROOT, name)
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(RELEASE_070_ORIGINALS))
def test_release_070_metadata_never_exempts_other_bytes(tmp_path, name):
    fixture = tmp_path / RELEASE_070_FIXTURE
    fixture.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    fixture.write_bytes((ROOT / RELEASE_070_FIXTURE).read_bytes())
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes((ROOT / name).read_bytes() + b"\n# Unreviewed metadata mutation.\n")
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        _release_070_bytes(tmp_path, name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_release_070_fixture_and_copied_validator_cannot_replace_trusted_guard(tmp_path, mutation):
    fixture = tmp_path / RELEASE_070_FIXTURE
    fixture.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    fixture.write_bytes((ROOT / RELEASE_070_FIXTURE).read_bytes())
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    data = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        replacement = hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if mutation == "slot":
            replacement = "f" * 64
        data = data.replace(RELEASE_070_SHA256.encode(), replacement.encode())
    if mutation == "helper":
        data = data.replace(
            b"def _release_070_bytes(root, name):", b"def _release_070_bytes(root, name): # changed"
        )
    path.write_bytes(data)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        _release_070_bytes(tmp_path, name)


def test_assembly_step_inverse_preserves_exact_parent_and_every_older_guard():
    added, originals = assembly_step_originals(ROOT)
    assert added == ASSEMBLY_STEP_ADDED and len(added) == 9
    assert set(originals) == set(ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS)
    for name, data in originals.items():
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS[name]
    test_snapshot3_source_and_all_old_kernel_evidence_spans_are_protected()
    test_assembly_integration_restores_exact_parent_and_all_historical_guards()


def test_assembly_step_inverse_rejects_every_changed_added_or_fixture_byte(monkeypatch):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    for name in sorted(
        ASSEMBLY_STEP_ADDED | ASSEMBLY_STEP_ORIGINALS.keys() | {ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE}
    ):
        target = ROOT / name
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(
                Path,
                "read_bytes",
                lambda path, target=target: (
                    read(path) + (b"\n# unreviewed\n" if path == target else b"")
                ),
            )
            with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
                assembly_step_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_assembly_step_copied_fixture_or_validator_cannot_replace_trusted_inverse(
    monkeypatch, mutation
):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    fixture = ROOT / ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    raw = read(fixture) + (b"\n" if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"} else b"")
    data = read(guard)
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() if mutation == "coordinated" else "f" * 64
        assert data.count(ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256.encode()) == 1
        data = data.replace(ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256.encode(), digest.encode())
    if mutation == "helper":
        marker = b"def _assembly_step_revision(root):\n"
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        data = data.replace(marker, marker + b"    # untrusted copied validator\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: raw if path == fixture else data if path == guard else read(path),
    )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        assembly_step_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    ["equivalent", "schema", "base", "path", "added_path", "original", "hunk", "added_hash"],
)
def test_assembly_step_inner_controls_keep_pinned_parent_and_finite_paths(monkeypatch, mutation):
    expected = assembly_step_originals(ROOT)
    fixture = ROOT / ASSEMBLY_STEP_FIXTURE
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    read = Path.read_bytes
    revision = json.loads(read(fixture))
    name = next(iter(revision["changed"]))
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "unreviewed"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "f" * 40
    elif mutation == "path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/unreviewed.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "added_path":
        revision["added"]["tests/unit/unreviewed.py"] = revision["added"].pop(
            next(iter(revision["added"]))
        )
    elif mutation == "original":
        revision["changed"][name]["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "hunk":
        revision["changed"][name]["hunks"][0]["new_start"] = True
    elif mutation == "added_hash":
        revision["added"][next(iter(revision["added"]))]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != read(fixture)
    digest, old = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256.encode()
    data = _release_071_bytes(ROOT, "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py")
    assert data.count(old) == 1
    data = data.replace(old, digest.encode())
    metadata_read = _release_071_bytes
    monkeypatch.setitem(
        globals(),
        "_release_071_bytes",
        lambda root, name, observed=None: (
            data
            if name == "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
            else metadata_read(root, name, observed)
        ),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: raw if path == fixture else data if path == guard else read(path),
    )
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "ASSEMBLY_STEP_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert assembly_step_originals(ROOT) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            assembly_step_originals(ROOT)


def test_release_071_metadata_restores_exact_parent_before_every_older_guard():
    for name, expected in RELEASE_071_ORIGINALS.items():
        data = _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected
    test_assembly_step_inverse_preserves_exact_parent_and_every_older_guard()
    test_release_070_metadata_restores_exact_eb9b51c_bytes()


def test_release_071_version_files_have_only_exact_metadata_changes():
    changes = {
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/__init__.py": (b"(0, 7, 1)", b"(0, 7, 0)", 1),
        "src/mechanical_cad/__init__.py": (b"0.7.1", b"0.7.0", 1),
        "scripts/standalone_child_bootstrap.py": (b"0.7.1", b"0.7.0", 1),
        "scripts/verify_sidecar_install.py": (b"0.7.1", b"0.7.0", 2),
    }
    for name, (current, previous, count) in changes.items():
        data = _visual_joint_bytes(ROOT, name)
        assert data.count(current) == count
        original = _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)
        normalized = data.replace(current, previous)
        assert normalized == original
        assert ast.dump(ast.parse(normalized)) == ast.dump(ast.parse(original))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(RELEASE_071_ORIGINALS))
def test_release_071_metadata_never_exempts_other_bytes(monkeypatch, name):
    read, target = Path.read_bytes, ROOT / name
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: (
            read(path) + (b"\n# unreviewed metadata mutation\n" if path == target else b"")
        ),
    )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_release_071_fixture_and_copied_validator_cannot_replace_trusted_guard(
    monkeypatch, mutation
):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    fixture = ROOT / RELEASE_071_FIXTURE
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    guard = ROOT / name
    raw = read(fixture) + (b"\n" if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"} else b"")
    data = read(guard)
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() if mutation == "coordinated" else "f" * 64
        assert data.count(RELEASE_071_SHA256.encode()) == 1
        data = data.replace(RELEASE_071_SHA256.encode(), digest.encode())
    if mutation == "helper":
        marker = b"def _release_071_bytes(root, name, data=None):\n"
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        data = data.replace(marker, marker + b"    # untrusted copied validator\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: raw if path == fixture else data if path == guard else read(path),
    )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["equivalent", "schema", "base", "path", "original", "hunk"])
def test_release_071_inner_controls_keep_pinned_parent_and_finite_paths(monkeypatch, mutation):
    fixture = ROOT / RELEASE_071_FIXTURE
    name = "src/mechanical_cad/__init__.py"
    expected = _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)
    read = Path.read_bytes
    revision = json.loads(read(fixture))
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "unreviewed"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "f" * 40
    elif mutation == "path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/unreviewed.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "original":
        revision["changed"][name]["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "hunk":
        revision["changed"][name]["hunks"][0]["new_start"] = True
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != read(fixture)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", lambda path: raw if path == fixture else read(path))
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "RELEASE_071_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            _release_071_bytes(ROOT, name)


def test_visual_joint_inverse_restores_exact_parent_and_all_historical_guards():
    added, originals = visual_joint_originals(ROOT)
    assert added == VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED
    assert set(originals) == set(VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS)
    assert {name for name in originals if name.startswith("blender_addon/")} == {
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/__init__.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_state.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_ui.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/registration.py",
    }
    assert {name for name in added if not name.startswith("tests/")} == {
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_joint_draft.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_joint_overlay.py",
        "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/assembly_joint_viewport.py",
    }
    assert {name for name in originals.keys() | added if name.startswith("src/")} == {
        "src/mechanical_cad/__init__.py"
    }
    for name, data in originals.items():
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS[name]
    test_release_071_metadata_restores_exact_parent_before_every_older_guard()


def test_visual_joint_inverse_rejects_every_changed_added_or_fixture_byte(monkeypatch):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    for name in sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED | VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS.keys() | {VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE}):
        target = ROOT / name
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(
                Path,
                "read_bytes",
                lambda path, target=target: (
                    read(path)
                    + (b"\n# unreviewed visual joint mutation\n" if path == target else b"")
                ),
            )
            with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
                visual_joint_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["fixture", "slot", "helper", "coordinated"])
def test_visual_joint_copied_fixture_and_validator_are_only_data(monkeypatch, mutation):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    fixture = ROOT / VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    raw = read(fixture) + (b"\n" if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"} else b"")
    data = read(guard)
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() if mutation == "coordinated" else "f" * 64
        assert data.count(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode()) == 1
        data = data.replace(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode(), digest.encode())
    if mutation == "helper":
        marker = b"def _visual_joint_revision(root):\n"
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        data = data.replace(marker, marker + b"    # copied validators are not trusted\n")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: raw if path == fixture else data if path == guard else read(path),
    )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        visual_joint_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mutation",
    [
        "equivalent",
        "schema",
        "base",
        "extra_key",
        "missing_changed",
        "missing_added",
        "changed_path",
        "added_path",
        "core_path",
        "original_hash",
        "original_length",
        "reviewed_hash",
        "reviewed_length",
        "entry_key",
        "empty_hunks",
        "hunk_key",
        "start_bool",
        "start_negative",
        "end_before_start",
        "end_overflow",
        "replacement",
        "original",
        "duplicate_hunk",
        "reversed_hunks",
        "forged_original",
        "added_hash",
        "added_length",
        "added_key",
    ],
)
def test_visual_joint_inner_controls_keep_finite_paths_hunks_and_before_pins(monkeypatch, mutation):
    expected = visual_joint_originals(ROOT)
    fixture = ROOT / VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    read = Path.read_bytes
    revision = json.loads(read(fixture))
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    hunk = entry["hunks"][0]
    added = revision["added"][sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0]]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "unreviewed"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "f" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["allow_other_paths"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing_changed":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "missing_added":
        revision["added"].pop(sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0])
    elif mutation == "changed_path":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/../unreviewed.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "added_path":
        revision["added"]["../unreviewed.py"] = revision["added"].pop(sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0])
    elif mutation == "core_path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation in {"original_hash", "reviewed_hash"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_hash", "_sha256")] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation in {"original_length", "reviewed_length"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length", "_bytes")] = True
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip_validation"] = True
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = True
    elif mutation == "start_negative":
        hunk["new_start"] = -1
    elif mutation == "end_before_start":
        hunk["new_end"] = hunk["new_start"] - 1
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":
        hunk["new_end"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation == "replacement":
        hunk["replacement"] += "# altered reviewed bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "original":
        hunk["original"] += "# altered before bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate_hunk":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    elif mutation == "reversed_hunks":
        assert len(entry["hunks"]) > 1
        entry["hunks"].reverse()
    elif mutation == "forged_original":
        before = expected[1][name] + b"\n# forged historical source\n"
        current = read(guard).replace(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode(), b"0" * 64)
        entry["original_bytes"] = len(before)
        entry["original_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": before.decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    elif mutation == "added_hash":
        added["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "added_length":
        added["bytes"] = True
    elif mutation == "added_key":
        added["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    else:
        assert mutation == "equivalent"
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != read(fixture)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    data = read(guard)
    assert data.count(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode()) == 1
    data = data.replace(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode(), digest.encode())
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        Path,
        "read_bytes",
        lambda path: raw if path == fixture else data if path == guard else read(path),
    )
    monkeypatch.setitem(globals(), "VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256", digest)
    if mutation == "equivalent":
        assert visual_joint_originals(ROOT) == expected
    else:
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            visual_joint_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "constant",
    sorted(
        name for name in globals() if name.endswith("_SHA256") and name != "VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256"
    ),
)
def test_visual_joint_normalizes_no_historical_digest_slot(monkeypatch, constant):
    read = Path.read_bytes
    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    data = read(guard)
    digest = globals()[constant].encode()
    assert data.count(digest) == 1
    data = data.replace(digest, b"f" * 64)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", lambda path: data if path == guard else read(path))
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        visual_joint_originals(ROOT)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED))
def test_visual_joint_missing_addition_is_never_reconstructed(monkeypatch, name):
    read, target = Path.read_bytes, ROOT / name

    def observed(path):
        if path == target:
            raise FileNotFoundError(str(path))
        return read(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", observed)
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        visual_joint_originals(ROOT)


def test_visual_joint_unlisted_python_remains_in_original_digest(tmp_path):
    copy_python_guard_tree(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_unreviewed_visual_joint.py").write_bytes(b"# unreviewed\n")
    assert protected_python_digest(tmp_path) != SNAPSHOT3_PYTHON_PROTECTED
